metrics.definition: All 640x480 RGB channels, values 0..255. No alignment, masks, exclusions or selection of a best frame. Both successive captures at every sample are compared.

readoutReview.method: Visual inspection of engine capture readouts; both images on all four engines agree.

imageReview: All three 24-image contact sheets inspected. World/weapon positions, shield coverage, beams and selected hit/burst effects agree closely. Residual differences remain, especially demo0001 sample 460.
limits: Nine Windows x86 Holomatch snapshot states, two successive captures each; not whole-game pixel identity.
RTX uses SDR raster output; native Windows RT remains unavailable on the tested driver.
No new SP, Linux, physical input, listening or force-feedback-device acceptance is established.
No production source changed; the complete suite was not rerun. Prior Windows build/suite evidence is linked separately.

cleanup.result: Automatic approval review rejected the bounded disposable-leaf cleanup before execution.
cleanup.note: No retry or alternative deletion attempted. Runtime binaries, probes, logs and screenshots are retained as evidence. Earlier cleanup-rejected directories remain untouched.
